title: Modules Exercises
explanation: Pon a prueba tus conocimientos sobre Modules resolviendo estos ejercicios.

exercises.question: What is the correct syntax to import a module named mymodule?
If you want to refer to a module by using a different name, you can create an alias. What is the correct syntax for creating an alias for a module?
What is the correct syntax of printing all variables and function names of the 'mymodule' module?
What is the correct syntax of importing only the person1 dictionary of the 'mymodule' module?
